notes: Drawings zoom and pan faster: a plain drawing is now drawn by the graphics card on every frame instead of in squares. The app first checks once, in the background, that the graphics card draws the page exactly, and remembers the answer; until then, and for any drawing it cannot draw exactly, the squares are used as before. A drawing whose PDF only names a font may show a slightly different font. Very small dots on a wide line are drawn solid. Dashes on curved lines sit at their true places. Settings > Drawings has a new box to turn the graphics card off.
